speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs constitution → specify → clarify → plan → checklist → tasks → analyze → implement → converge with review gates, repeating implement ↔ converge until converge reports Converged (ADR-013); extensions: assess (optional before_specify intake hook), bug (triage), git (git.initialize, git.feature mandatory; git.commit optional, disabled by default)
